{{Quote|Isotope-5...Toborro's great discovery at the center of Makeb. Something truly unique in all the galaxy&ndash;and worth destroying this planet to obtain. Imagine a substance as light as shimmersilk but stronger than durasteel. It distorts gravity and electromagnetic fields so predictably that it can be refined into fuel.|Dr. [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]]|<ref name="Expert">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Consulting the Expert|Makeb}}</ref>}}
'''Isotope-5''' was one of the rarest substances in the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], secretly discovered by deep-core mining operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] after it was [[Conquest of Makeb|conquered]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Discovered to be a [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] form of [[illerium]],<ref name="Expert" /> and named for the fifth known isotopic variation of an [[:Category:Elements|element]] normally found in [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]], isotope-5 had powerful warping effects on [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] and [[Spectrum/Legends|electromagnetic]] fields even in minuscule quantities. Research into the substance's capabilities showed that it was relatively stable, and could theoretically be altered into a form capable of channeling massive amounts of energy through particle bombardment.<ref name="Isotope-5">{{TORcite|type=codex|Isotope-5}}</ref> Such was the nature of isotope-5 that scientists speculated a single microgram of the substance could power a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] for an entire [[Standard century/Legends|century]].<ref name="Iso-5Droid">{{TORcite|type=codex|Isotope-5 Droids}}</ref> The gravity-warping properties of isotope-5 were believed to be the cause of Makeb's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] interference and the unusual mesa formations that dotted the surface.<ref name="Isotope-5" />

Isotope-5 was a major part of [[Toborro]] the Hutt's plan to raise the Hutt Cartel as a galactic superpower to rival the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the battle for Makeb, the Hutt scientists developed a number of combat uses for the substance, including a series of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] to attack Makeb's civilians and resistance forces, powered by [[Isotope-5 fuel rod|isotope-5]] [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel rods]] that generated stronger [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]] and more powerful [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="Iso-5Droid" />

Brought to the brink of collapse by the reversals of fortune in the [[Galactic War]], the Sith Empire sent a small strike force under the command of [[Darth Marr]] to the planet in order to either obtain the substance for themselves, or destroy the Hutt Cartel's efforts in obtaining it. Unfortunately, they used all but one sample of isotope-5 in developing their droids and there was no way to extract it from them. Worse yet, the Hutts' mining had destabilized Makeb's core, causing [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and threatened to destroy the planet, thereby ruining the Empire's plans. However, an Imperial think tank was able to devise a way to use [[Mining laser/Legends|mining lasers]] to set off controlled groundquakes, setting the core towards equilibrium.
